title: Chintamani Library v2.8.17 — Universal QR Portal to Member Directory & Admin Portal Repair
releaseNotes: MEMBER DIRECTORY SYNC: Registrations through Universal QR Portal now immediately create active Member records and active Subscriptions in the authoritative database so they appear instantly in Member Directory.
PAY VERIFY ADMIN SECTION: Added full Pay Verify view with interactive high-resolution screenshot preview modal, UTR details, and 1-tap Approve/Reject actions.
COMPLAINTS ADMIN SECTION: Added dedicated Member Complaints & Issues view with category chips, branch badges, and Mark Resolved workflow.
CROSS-BRANCH ACCESS: Admin portal now defaults to ALL branches on load, preventing records from being hidden by active branch filters.
DATABASE BACKFILL: Automatically backfills all existing portal registrations into Member directory on startup.
